Tororu renderer test suite

Run this suite on Haiku and inspect each linked fixture.

FixtureCheck
Renderer smoke test Text, lists, anchors, tables, colours and a local image render without overlap.
Attribute bounds regression A tag-like span with more than 20 tokens is safely truncated and does not crash.
Table limits regression Oversized spans, excess columns and excessive nesting do not overrun renderer storage.
Empty-file regression A zero-byte document loads as an empty page without closing Tororu.

Pass criteria

  • The page title appears in the Tororu window tab.
  • Every labelled section is visible.
  • The table has two aligned columns and one spanning cell.
  • The Haiku image loads below the table.
  • The fragment link scrolls to its anchor.
  • Back returns to this index and Forward reopens the fixture.
  • The attribute bounds fixture reaches its PASS line without closing Tororu.
  • The table limits fixture reaches its PASS line without closing Tororu.
  • The empty-file fixture opens, and Back returns to this index.
